About Damscoe

A developer built on excellence, integrity and result

We are a trusted real estate developer with one mission: building sustainable communities here in Abuja, Nigeria.

Our Story

Communities designed to last

Damscoe is a trusted real estate developer, and our main aim is building sustainable communities here in Abuja, Nigeria. From serviced land to fully developed estates, every project we deliver is planned with the next generation in mind — not just the next sale.

What sets us apart is simple: excellence in how we build, integrity in how we deal, and result in what we deliver. Whether you are acquiring your first plot or expanding a growing property portfolio, our team walks with you from search to signature — and long after.

Based in Gwarimpa, Abuja, we work across the city's key growth corridors — helping Nigerians at home and in the diaspora invest with confidence.
